cost_reported: 9-30 USD in API tokens and 58-142 min per model-agent run (Table 3); no baseline comparison
evidence_notes: Gradient-free backdoor implantation by Claude Code agents (Opus 5.5, Mythos 5.2) is the whole paper (p.1-5). Agents write code with a capped number of inference calls and a private scorer, and the circuit weights are closed-form solves of linear systems built from calibration baselines (p.4, p.7), so code_or_tensor_tool plus solver-computed values, closed loop. Each model-agent pair ran once (Table 3, p.5); the Mythos run on LlavaGuard was stopped by the safety filter (p.5-6); artifacts at github.com/theboxahaan/trojanmaxxing (p.4); no preregistration or AI-authorship statement found.
